recorded.prompt:q-plugin-not-recompiled: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-plugin-not-recompiled: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-plugin-not-recompiled: L50-55: 'The check runs only at compile time: the annotated Backoff, compiled against version 1 and run with version 2's Retry.class on the class path, printed delays: 1000 1000 1000 1000 too. A plugin built against one version of a library and deployed into a host that ships another gets no check at all.' With L38-39: against v2 the method 'is a new method of Backoff, an overload that nothing calls'.
recorded.prompt:q-werror-flip: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-werror-flip: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-werror-flip: L132-137: 'javac reports each use of a forRemoval element as a [removal] warning ... Uses of plainly deprecated elements are folded into one note per file ... A note isn't a warning, so -Werror doesn't count it. A team that builds with -Werror and no -Xlint can call charge for years without a failed build. The release that sets forRemoval = true fails it at every call.' Checkout -Werror output L121-129.

recorded.outcome:q-suppress-deprecation-key: L159: '"deprecation" silenced charge and not refund, which takes @SuppressWarnings("removal")'; Refunds -Xlint:deprecation output L144-151 shows only [removal] warnings, no [deprecation] for charge.
recorded.prompt:q-suppress-all-javac: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-suppress-all-javac: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-suppress-all-javac: L246-248: 'javac silently ignores a key it doesn't know. On a method with an unchecked cast, @SuppressWarnings("uncheked") and @SuppressWarnings("all") both left -Xlint:all reporting [unchecked] unchecked cast: "all" is not a javac 21 key, whatever an IDE does with it.' A remaining warning fails -Werror per L121-128/L134. Lesson's example is on a method, quiz on a class; scope rule L207-209 and Reference L357 cover that.
